contributor_guide.1_what_can_i_work_on: Select any mission with status 'Open' in this catalog.
contributor_guide.2_how_difficult_is_it: D1-D4 is specification depth (spec_depth), NOT difficulty. Difficulty and execution level (L0-L3) are separate axes, reported NO_DATA until measured.
contributor_guide.3_has_another_taken_it: Inspect status field and open pull requests on preceptoros-public-mesa.
contributor_guide.4_allowed_files: Create files in missions/MISSION-ID/ or propose branch documentation. Never edit CI or security gates.
contributor_guide.5_how_to_prove_completion: Provide receipts with COMMAND, OUTPUT, MACHINE, DATE, and PATH.
contributor_guide.6_how_to_submit: Fork repo, create branch MISSION-ID-title, submit Draft PR titled HITL · MISSION-ID · Description.
contributor_guide.7_who_reviews_and_signs: The Sovereign reviews, executes HITL, signs (FIRMO), and merges.
